gui_reviews.evidence_limit: Probe6 trace: 35 scene entries use matching HAL D24S8; 3464 default-target operations have no pair mismatch. Trace is bounded to 1.422 seconds; visible flicker and lifecycle stress remain open.

RGBA/DXT independent row/block strides and actual public allocation geometry checked. Old 3x5 RGBA copy overflows 60-byte storage with 512 bytes; no attribution to the remaining CreateTexture driver fault.

Original PYC URI, complete original SetPixel loop and installed ResIL/ILU decode buffers agree for 16384 pixels. A Windows SWF has all twelve 128x128 opaque BitmapData objects. A separate no-readback/no-display-tree-inspection run visibly renders all camouflage and filter thumbnails. Earlier provider-ACK screenshots were premature; a URI request is not image-complete/render acknowledgement. This proves the exercised VM scene, not all hardware or image families. 3D customization is a separate owner.
Public binding declarations, Movie/MovieDef/value/display/input schemas have focused tests. All original defaults/errors and every DisplayInfo conversion are not certified.
Memory-texture APIs are separate missing original exports. Sticker parsing retains placeholder production; no exact PYC producer found, SWF literals remain unreviewed.
Font/proxy/Capture/reset/lease tests are not complete DPI, CJK eviction, tooltip cache invalidation, render-thread-off A/B or visual lifecycle evidence.

Pre-mip probe6 still faulted after row-copy/overlay repairs. After the separately demonstrated independent-mip RawImage::Decode repair, garage-probe3 / vm-93d69269-202611021305 completed acceptance-probe8-complete exit0: 148 hover inputs, repeated tabs, actual styleId0-to1 preview, buyAndExit, two battle shots, garage return and quit. No general driver-cause or future-crash-freedom claim.

Pinned RawImage::Decode reused a previous mip destination across independent mapped allocations. Real SDK decoder/geometry with guarded mips rejects old code and passes corrected code, including three original DDS uploads. Each destination mip is selected and bounded independently; current bounded Windows journey completed.

The exact battle SWF enables cacheAsBitmap on the entries mask. Extracted real SDK functions leak color in 8/48 baseline cases and 0/48 patched cases. A Windows battle trace exercises 5 uncached mask passes and 2490 parent mask composites, all with hardware COLORWRITEENABLE=0. This is bounded state evidence, not all-frame visual acceptance.

limitations: Reviewed gaps are not waivers of product defects. A successful comparison means no unreviewed surface regression within this census.
Missing optional exact-client/SDK/runtime data are not successful native tests.
Export names, source schema, actual instruction/CPU comparisons, Windows GPU images and crash diagnosis remain separate evidence tiers.

Used only for languages in _STR_CASING_OPTIONS; other languages use Python upper/lower. Native absence is caught by the utility exception handler.
Clan emblem, rare-achievement, event-board and server-event image paths require validated image bytes. This is separate from the img://camouflage compositor.
Selected combat areas, map-authored activities and destructible-fashion fallback have direct stock calls. Active selected maps, abilities and NG owner routing remain unproved.
physics_shared.updateCommonConf directly forwards 22 parameter calls. Its stock init owner must be checked against NG native physics startup before treating this as current gameplay failure.
OS queries are in New Year reward animation quality selection; hasMods requires stock recording; FPS metadata requires the replay-version-mismatch path.
Original online login, external browser/launcher and cryptographic cache paths. Offline entry bypasses parts of login; exact retained feature reachability must be proved individually.
All extracted direct consumers are stock bootcamp state/loading/hangar methods, not the ordinary LAN room transition.
game.init calls autoFlushPythonLog only under IS_DEVELOPMENT. wg_writeToStdOut is in the scriptedTest startup argument branch.
Roccat and force-feedback effect paths require their hardware/controller lifecycle. A missing peripheral operation must not be replaced by success.

createOscillatorFromSection selects it only when section.name is noiseOscillator. Authored selected camera configs must establish activation; ordinary oscillator and both random-noise factories already exist.

Live native Owner/Status/drive gates, checkpoint/HUD, Bot equipment and server repair combinations are exercised by focused tests. A repaired canonical track with newer revision and unchanged damage base must replace the local destroyed overlay without waiting for an unrelated auto-repair ACK. Other damaged track progress and sequence identity are preserved. Lifecycle guards and per-round reconstruction are source-reviewed; actual Windows repair-kit movement remains a separate acceptance boundary.

renderer_reviews.evidence_and_boundary: Exact HIGH/MEDIUM quality tables select original dynamic_shadows shader12: nine fixed weighted D16 comparison samples, kernel scale .9/physical atlas size, visibility accumulation then 1-sum. Actual patched R32F filter is compared against this contract over planes, narrow casters, screen translations and mixed tile boundaries. GTX1070 moving-image acceptance remains separate. Full HIGH Type62 Windows VM sequences complete translation/rotation/garage return with exit0; GTX1070 remains unproved.
renderer_reviews.finding: The public receiver used rotating screen-space Poisson taps rather than original HIGH/MEDIUM fixed weighted comparison filtering; the R32F adapter also lost bilinear comparison weights and receiver-plane depth agreement.

renderer_reviews.evidence_and_boundary: Original dynamic_shadows VS0 bytecode pins TAA ray subtraction. CameraDirs producer is unjittered; TAA.xy and reciprocal viewport TAA.zw are already normalized against the scene viewport. Depth UV remains unchanged. Old half-pixel ray control fails across AA off/on and DRR.
renderer_reviews.finding: Legacy texture UV includes a half texel; original ray does not. Temporal jitter was also absent from legacy ray reconstruction.

renderer_reviews.evidence_and_boundary: Original ASM receive COLORWRITEENABLE=4. All 464 shader variants audited: 2 effects/32 shaders bind ShadowScreenSpaceMap, only R/B reach output, no G consumer. Static terrain/object occlusion is unioned before PCF and written to B; active legacy helper follows the same convention.
renderer_reviews.finding: Public terrain coverage went to GREEN, but the original lighting shader consumes only RED/BLUE.

renderer_reviews.evidence_and_boundary: This is a D3DX wrapper consistency fix, not a claim that original ARIE Definition default getters were wrong. Current material Binding/private clone/context/padded array/selection/raw/texture reads tested; Definition adapters, immutable Reflection and provider default reads preserved, including matching-layout effects with different defaults. Previous read body fails after SetFloat.
renderer_reviews.finding: The D3DX compatibility wrapper returned immutable defaults after material Set calls.

renderer_reviews.evidence_and_boundary: No current crash attribution. Explicit parameter clearing now precedes target release; real SDK delete methods pass reference-count tests for repeat/partial teardown, and each old owner separately fails the retaining-reference negative control.
renderer_reviews.finding: Dynamic and semi-static legacy receiver effects retain manually bound DEFAULT-pool atlas/indirection textures when their resource owner drops the targets.

renderer_reviews.evidence_and_boundary: Original CursorCamera79cf65 and SpeedTreeTargetedCamera7978e0 forward focus through9c5dd0/96ea70/9cd1d0 independently of tree hiding. Original HIGH/MEDIUM first cascade is tight-fit and unsnapped; focus<12m narrows first far to distance+.5, focus12..30m uses the focus box and .4 split lambda. Original9cded0 rectangle arithmetic matches250 instruction-oracle cases exactly. Full projection-wrapper instruction parity, other profiles, far-cascade radius hysteresis and original full distance/ASM agreement remain open. Full HIGH Type62 Windows VM sequences complete translation/rotation/garage return with exit0; GTX1070 remains unproved.
renderer_reviews.finding: Camera renderer target publication omitted the directional-shadow focus. HIGH/MEDIUM used equal 1024 sphere/snapped cascades instead of the original nearest 2048 tight projection; view-Z selection could miss the nearest light-space volume.

renderer_reviews.evidence_and_boundary: Do not apply the recovered directional split .7 formula to ASM by assumption. Static ASM caster projection/bias/guard-texel behavior needs its own original producer evidence and Windows image acceptance.
renderer_reviews.finding: Public semi_terrain2_cast adds a hardcoded normalized .01 to COLOR depth. Its static object path uses original SHADOW effects.

renderer_reviews.evidence_and_boundary: WorldApp casts before opaque draw and republishes shared constants; DBE/material reconstruction precedes decals, then shadow resolve and original SUN. Static source proves ordering, not driver execution.
renderer_reviews.finding: Scene SSSM is explicitly DRR-applicable; atlas/reflection targets retain independent dimensions. RenderTarget push/pop saves view/projection/viewport.

renderer_reviews.evidence_and_boundary: Texture unbinding and target/camera scopes are explicit. Tests establish ABI/lifecycle boundaries; no new exact Windows photometric or timing parity claim.
renderer_reviews.finding: Native omni/spot owners use actual per-light view/projection/algorithm, shared constants, independent targets and scoped restoration.

renderer_reviews.evidence_and_boundary: Terrain-specific conversion, multipass channels and x86 vertex layout covered in existing tests. Static shadow B-channel defect fixed above. No claim that all retail terrain quality families are implemented.
renderer_reviews.finding: Original terrain layout is converted with its authored AO/shadow alpha and texture/material schema; public scene depth comes from INTZ to R32F hierarchy.

renderer_reviews.evidence_and_boundary: ST6/Flora-ST6 owners are explicitly absent. Missing AsmParams/Asm texture providers in original forward/reflection shader variants remain a capability candidate until selected live variants are identified.
renderer_reviews.finding: Current renderer uses ST4/Flora families, real materials atlas, instance transforms/wind, targeted hiding, and dedicated forward-lighting inputs.

renderer_reviews.evidence_and_boundary: Legacy common Screen and original ARIE Screen layouts differ intentionally and are separately produced. Actual animation pose agreement at shadow and color draws remains a Windows acceptance item.
renderer_reviews.finding: Definition handles, per-material Binding, object/instance/bone palette ownership and original COLOR/SHADOW passes have focused coverage.

renderer_reviews.evidence_and_boundary: Source/tests cover borrowed texture leases, phases, local failure and clearing. Legacy reconstruction inherits TAA/half-pixel fix. No new GPU blend/occlusion parity claim.
renderer_reviews.finding: 124-byte static/dynamic/vehicle decal packets, typed selectors, object-kind copy and original GBuffer targets share one explicit draw owner.

renderer_reviews.evidence_and_boundary: Actual original water shaders bind ASM semantics in some compiled variants, not ShadowScreenSpaceMap. Presence of a declaration/variant alone does not prove the missing ASM owner affects the live water quality/selection.
renderer_reviews.finding: Water BWWa2 geometry/parameters, resource conversions, ripples and query lifecycle have focused owners; legacy world reconstruction separates DRR depth UV from reflection/refraction UV.

renderer_reviews.evidence_and_boundary: External/nested emitters are explicitly rejected, with a diagnostic, rather than approximated. No matching report diagnostic yet ties such a subclass to the firing white line.
renderer_reviews.finding: Original tPS uses lit_particles two-stream schema, explicit scalar/bool/int selectors, per-frame ParticlesParams and the transparent user-item queue.

renderer_reviews.evidence_and_boundary: The historical shimmer path writes a separate distortion RT that no original DX9 shader consumes. Removing it from scene color is not by itself a missing observable feature.
renderer_reviews.finding: Legacy mesh particles install TintPalette through direct getMapping, so a literal registerAutoConstant search alone is insufficient.

renderer_reviews.evidence_and_boundary: This is distinct from original environment/lens_flare, the HDR postprocess. Public FlareData mesh matches the fixed-function resource; no vertex-schema mismatch was established for the firing line.
renderer_reviews.finding: Known fx_sun_flare MFM points to system/materials/flare.fx, a fixed-function legacy TLUV2/two-UV-stage material.

renderer_reviews.evidence_and_boundary: Observable capability differences under matching retail settings, not a demonstrated cause of the present white line or heap failure. Original profiles, HDR target DRR and tone-mapping fields have focused coverage.
renderer_reviews.finding: Original bloom/lens flare/dirt/god-ray owners are absent; ToneMapping explicitly publishes zero bloom tint and disables lens flare/god rays. SSR is explicitly disabled in SUN/local lights.

renderer_reviews.evidence_and_boundary: Matching garage-probe3 acceptance-probe8-complete completed tab/preview/buyAndExit, battle shots and garage return with exit0 after per-mip repair. Controlled SWF camouflage image, moving-shadow image and unexercised lifecycle acceptance remain separate.
renderer_reviews.finding: Scaleform owns its render-thread snapshot/target state; GUI AA/sniper lens/FlashBang/final DRR composition are separate from scene GBuffer/shadow owners.
The loose public SDK graphics preset catalogue had12 entries and shadowed the pinned19-entry catalogue. HIGH selected different shadow quality and omitted seven authored settings.
renderer_reviews.evidence_and_boundary: Resource patch removes only the SDK preset override. Real original package lookup, full native/Python2 catalogue consumer, complete HIGH settings and cached/idempotent generation are tested. Original client package remains unchanged. Windows native getter returns original19 fields; preset application records matching HIGH textures/LOD/lighting/terrain1 and shadows2, then completes gameplay and normal exit0.

renderer_reviews.finding: The SDK queue also carries context shutdown; drain plus caller Execute violated asynchronous Push and render-cache thread ownership. Final Renderer/HAL release remained on caller.
renderer_reviews.evidence_and_boundary: Actual SDK Context::Shutdown holds its lock while admitting RT service work, then waits after unlocking. Commands retain leases and run asynchronously; all producers share one FIFO with a monotonic published-record fence and explicit completion acknowledgement before final RT release. RT scene helpers avoid main RenderContext mutable state. Matching symbols place an intermittent pre-fix exit AV in MeshKeyManager cleanup, but no matching dump was captured and causality is not asserted.

renderer_reviews.finding: The public HDR path generated bloom while final original tone mapping forced its tint to zero. DBE also downsampled and filtered neutral channels after all of their light consumers were disabled.
renderer_reviews.evidence_and_boundary: Exact map HDR settings and finite black DDS mips are inspected. Keep luminance targets/AA, use managed finite black bloom input, preserve a physically cleared neutral DBE target, and disable unused ScalarTAA so reactivation reseeds history. Actual producer bodies, cache upgrade, retirement, quality transitions and failure cleanup are tested. No GTX1070 frame-time gain is claimed by source/host checks.

renderer_reviews.finding: Automatic uniform capture copied immutable names/semantics on every numeric write; named reflection calls constructed temporary owning strings.
renderer_reviews.evidence_and_boundary: Actual adapter/storage and full reflection paths have allocation-counting regressions with old-behavior negative controls. Numeric layout, writer policy, lexical ordering, embedded NUL semantics, null adapter guards and encoded handles remain covered. Views are call-local and never retained. This is not a cross-frame constant-upload cache or a claim about total renderer frame cost.

renderer_reviews.finding: Visibility traversals copied every hit node list; stock instance batches uploaded unused public full-matrix streams; effect draws updated inactive texture providers and repeatedly searched shared capture/initialisation metadata.
renderer_reviews.evidence_and_boundary: Actual SDK bodies preserve intersection sets, collision callback copies, instance ordering/offsets and stock/public failure isolation. Pure-stock batches require no public matrix upload; mixed batches upload their used prefix. Used automatic texture values still refresh each draw; only their selection metadata is retained. Shared initialisation and capture indexing retain producer/cleanup contracts. No GTX1070 frame-rate gain is established by host tests; the dormant original small-object cull branch is not treated as an active parity gap.

renderer_reviews.finding: Original main-scene GPU occlusion history filters eligible objects before draw-set admission; the NG compiled-space main scene currently uses frustum culling without this query-result filter.
renderer_reviews.source: Original #1513 WorldApp 0x636c05/0x636dd1, query owner 0xabad80, history 0xac20a0 and consumer 0xac1d95; public client/world_app.cpp compiled-space path.
renderer_reviews.evidence_and_boundary: Exact instruction producer/consumer slices route an identical eligible candidate to skip 0xac1e64 or append 0xac1e3f according to GPU-query visibility history. This is distinct from the dormant small-object branch. No desktop FPS contribution or safe replacement query lifecycle has been established.

renderer_reviews.finding: The desktop peak performs 271.89 locks/frame creating identical 64-byte native index streams in ephemeral RenderOpProcessors; stock-only processors also allocated unused 256 KiB public matrix buffers.
renderer_reviews.evidence_and_boundary: Matching packaged executable/PDB attributes caller RVA 0x0097a982 to RenderOpProcessor::createUnmanagedObjects. Shared EVC/DeviceCallback ownership initializes native indices once per device lifetime; public buffers allocate only for an actual public consumer. Host tests preserve failure/reset/mixed packet contracts; Windows FPS gain is not established.
